controls: Personal data that cannot be attributed to a specific natural person without the use of additional information, provided that such additional information is kept separately and is subject to appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure that the personal data is not attributed to an identified or identifiable natural person (§ 59.1-575). The consumer rights in subdivisions A 1 through 4 of § 59.1-577 and § 59.1-578 do not apply where the controller demonstrates that identifying information is kept separately and subject to effective technical and organizational controls that prevent the controller from accessing it (§ 59.1-581(D)).
